note: Open sea continues across the full east and south boundaries, including the water outside the southeast shingle cove and the southern submerged-route approach.
Still green-tinted flooded quarry pit in the lowest centre-east cut; it remains visually and hydrologically distinct from the drainage run.
Continuous narrow drainage run entering from the northwest plateau, following the quarry gully past the pit, and reaching the south-coast cove.
Short vertical drop where the northwest drainage run crosses the central cut face; the lower cove descent remains part of the stream mouth.
